title: Astronomers discover the most distant and ancient supermassive black hole-powered quasar in the universe
caption:
Astronomers have identified the most distant and ancient quasar ever recorded, named Dún Aonghasa. At 360 million times the mass of the sun, this giant existed just 630 million years after the Big Bang, challenging our understanding of how quickly black holes can grow.

Source: Space - Astronomers discover the most distant and ancient supermassive black hole-powered quasar in the universe
